revised_document:
**Without prejudice and subject to contract — draft terms for discussion only**

We acknowledge the proposal to settle the fictional commercial tenancy dispute (LEX_004) for INR 4,200,000. No settlement is accepted, and no party is bound unless and until the terms are approved by the respective clients and recorded in a definitive written agreement signed by all parties.

Subject to our client’s independent review and approval, any settlement agreement should provide for: (1) payment of the agreed settlement amount within 15 business days after execution; (2) mutual releases limited to claims arising from the tenancy dispute through the agreement’s effective date; (3) confidentiality, subject to disclosures required by law, to professional advisers, insurers, auditors, or for enforcement of the agreement; (4) no admission of liability; and (5) appropriate steps to discontinue any related proceedings after cleared payment. Please confirm whether your client is willing to document the proposal on this basis. All rights are reserved pending written agreement.
